title: peucedanum terebinthaceum var. deltoideum
intro: Peucedanum terebinthaceum var. deltoideum, commonly known as the variegated hemlock or variegated cow parsley, is a plant species within the carrot family (Apiaceae) known for its distinct foliage. It is used in traditional medicine due to its reported health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce pain and inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial effects. The bioactive constituents of Peucedanum terebinthaceum var. deltoideum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
